docs.name: migraine
symptoms: Last 4 to 72 hours ,  Neck pain ,  Migraine with aura (classic migraine) ,  Sweating ,  Temporary blind spots or colored spots ,  Start as a dull ache and get worse within minutes to hours ,  Are worse on one side of the head with pain behind the eye or in the back of the head and neck ,  Are throbbing, pounding, or pulsating ,  Feeling mentally dull, like your thinking is not clear or sharp ,  Needing more sleep ,  Migraine without aura (common migraine) ,  Blurred vision ,  Seeing stars, zigzag lines, or flashing lights ,  Loss of appetite ,  Tunnel vision (only able to see objects close to the center of the field of view) ,  Increased urination ,  Chills ,  Sensitivity to light or sound ,  Eye pain ,  Fatigue ,  Nausea and vomiting
docs.description: I've been experiencing some debilitating migraine episodes over the last 4 to 72 hours, which usually start as a dull ache and rapidly worsen within minutes to hours. The pain is typically throbbing, pounding, or pulsating and is usually worse on one side of my head, often accompanied by pain behind my eye or in the back of my head and neck. I've also been dealing with neck pain, and sometimes I get a migraine with aura, which is characterized by temporary blind spots or colored spots, blurred vision, seeing stars, zigzag lines, or flashing lights, and even tunnel vision. Additionally, I've been feeling mentally dull, like my thinking is not clear or sharp, and I've been needing more sleep. I've also noticed that I've been experiencing increased urination, chills, and sensitivity to light or sound. Furthermore, I've been experiencing eye pain, fatigue, nausea, and vomiting, which have also been accompanied by a loss of appetite.

docs.name: cerebral_arteriovenous_malformation
symptoms: Problems walking ,  Numbness in an area of the body ,  Ear noise/buzzing (also called pulsatile tinnitus) ,  Dizziness ,  Headache in one or more parts of the head, may seem like a migraine ,  Confusion ,  Vision problems ,  Muscle weakness in an area of the body or face
docs.description: I've been experiencing some concerning symptoms lately, including problems with walking and numbness in certain areas of my body. I've also been dealing with a strange ear noise or buzzing, which I've learned is called pulsatile tinnitus. Additionally, I've been feeling dizzy and having headaches that seem to be migrating to different parts of my head, almost like a migraine. To make matters worse, I've been experiencing confusion, vision problems, and muscle weakness in certain areas of my body and even my face.

docs.name: fibromyalgia
symptoms: Reduced ability to exercise ,  Physical activity ,  Numbness and tingling in hands and feet ,  Memory and concentration problems ,  Tension or migraine headaches ,  Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) or gastroesophageal reflux (GERD) ,  It may feel like a deep ache, or a stabbing, burning pain. ,  Anxiety and stress ,  Cold or damp weather ,  It may feel like it is coming from the joints, although the joints are not affected.
docs.description: I've been experiencing a range of symptoms that are affecting my daily life, including a reduced ability to exercise due to physical activity leaving me exhausted. I've also been dealing with numbness and tingling sensations in my hands and feet, as well as memory and concentration problems that make it difficult to focus. Additionally, I've been suffering from tension or migraine headaches, and I've noticed that I've developed irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) or gastroesophageal reflux (GERD). The pain I'm experiencing is a deep ache, sometimes stabbing or burning, and it's unclear whether it's coming from my joints or not. All of these symptoms seem to be exacerbated by anxiety and stress, and I've noticed that they worsen in cold or damp weather.
